origin.note: The corpus is a published site whose pages reconstruct each instrument from Akoma Ntoso 3.0 (OASIS LegalDocML). Digests are over the published HTML at the commit above, which is what this encoding actually read; they are NOT digests of the underlying ministry PDFs, which the corpus records separately in each page's own provenance block.

annotations.note: The corpus pages carry no in-force banner and no amendment markers, so there are no annotations to dispose of. What each page DOES carry is a provenance note saying how its text was recovered — read from a word-processor file, transcribed from a scan by a single reader, extracted from a PDF, or taken from a hand-verified CSV — and those notes are reproduced per document in document-register.json under `caveats`.
